You stay calm in complex situations and make well-founded decisions. You collaborate easily across disciplines and value the responsibility of protecting public health, food safety, and animal welfare.Job requirements• You hold a veterinary degree that qualifies for Dutch Veterinary Register registration.• You speak English at B2 level and are willing to learn Dutch.• You hold a category B driving licence.• You are prepared to relocate and complete the full training program.• Experience in the veterinary or food sector is an advantage.• You work independently and carefully in a regulated environment.Competencies• analyzing• judgement• collaboration• planning and organizing• perseverance• stress resilienceSelection process• Pre-selection based on CV and motivation letter• Mandatory online information session: 29 January or 26 February• Intake interview: 2 February till 1 April• Written case study and first formal interview: 11 February till 13 April• English language test and competency assessment: 24 February till 29 may• Second interview: 8 April till 12 June• Employment conditions discussion: June*Please note: the dates are provisional and may still be subject to change

A new country. A modern dental practice. And the opportunity to become an important part of a team that is building for the future.At Steenwijkerdiep, you will work as a General Dentist in a professional and well-equipped group practice in Steenwijk. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues, have access to modern equipment and high-quality materials, and receive support with the practical steps involved in starting your career in the Netherlands.Your roleAs a General Dentist at Steenwijkerdiep, you will provide a broad range of general dental care to your patients.You will work in a professional environment where patient-centred care, quality and teamwork are central. You will have the freedom and resources to focus on good dentistry, while being supported by an experienced team around you.This position also offers the opportunity to become an important part of the future of the practice. There is room for you to take on a key role within the team and grow with the practice over time.About SteenwijkerdiepSteenwijkerdiep is a modern dental practice located in Steenwijk, the Netherlands.Our group practice offers a broad scope of dental care and consists of a multidisciplinary team of dentists, dental hygienists and dental assistants. By combining professional expertise with advanced equipment and high-quality materials, we aim to provide our patients with the highest possible standard of care.The atmosphere within the practice is professional, collaborative and patient-focused.What we are looking forFor this position, you have:•    Completed a relevant study in the sector Health-technical professions at WO/Master’s degree level;•    A minimum B1 level of English and the willingness to learn the Dutch language;•    A minimum of 3 months’ work experience as a dentist;•    A category B driving licence.What we offerYou can expect:•    A salary between €3,300 and €5,500 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience;•    An annual contract for 32–40 hours per week, with the intention of offering a permanent contract;•    Variable working hours;•    Excellent secondary employment conditions;•    A modern and professional workplace;•    Support with finding accommodation;•    Support and information regarding the recognition of your foreign diploma and your possibilities to work during that period.A practical start in the NetherlandsMoving abroad for work involves more than simply finding the right job. Having a place to live from the start makes that transition considerably easier. Accommodation is available at two residential parks, both located approximately 4–5 kilometres by bicycle from the practice. The homes can be rented for a minimum period of three months, subject to availability, with several accommodation options available for different situations.This gives you the possibility to arrange accommodation close to your workplace when you first arrive in the Netherlands, giving you time to settle into your new job and surroundings without having to immediately search for housing on your own.Interested in joining Steenwijkerdiep?We are looking for a General Dentist who values high-quality care, enjoys working as part of a professional team and would like to build a long-term career in the Netherlands.For more information about the position, the recognition process for your foreign diploma, the possibilities to work during this period or the application process, please contact: iris.vermeer@uwv.nl

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technician – Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Are you a hands-on technician who likes fixing things, solving technical problems and working with machines? Would you also like to use your technical skills in an industry that gives plastic a second life? We are looking for an All-round Maintenance Technician to join the technical team. What will you do? You will be part of the technical maintenance team and help keep the recycling plant running safely and reliably. Your work can include: Preventive and corrective maintenance Finding and solving technical problems Mechanical repairs Basic electrical troubleshooting Maintenance on pumps, motors, valves and production equipment Replacing and repairing mechanical components Helping when there is a breakdown Working together with production operators and other technicians Improving the reliability of machines and installations It is a hands-on technical job with plenty of variety. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We want to make the move to the Netherlands worthwhile. You can expect: A Dutch employment contract A competitive salary based on your experience 3200 - 4200 euro gross, per month Additional benefits according to the Dutch employment package A stable, full-time position in an international industrial company Support with your relocation to the Netherlands Help with finding accommodation and arranging practical matters Opportunities to learn, develop and grow within the technical team Functie-eisen You could be a good match if you: Have a background in mechanics, electromechanics, mechatronics, electricity or industrial maintenance Have experience as a maintenance technician, mechanic, electromechanical technician or similar Enjoy practical technical work Have some knowledge of both mechanical and electrical systems Are comfortable working in an industrial environment Can communicate in English Are interested in moving to the Netherlands You don't need to know everything. If you are technically minded, like working with your hands and are willing to learn, we would like ttalk to you. Hier kom je te werken The factory is focused on plastic recycling. Used PET bottles are collected, sorted, cleaned and processed into high-quality recycled plastic material. This material can then be used again for new bottles, packaging, fibres and other products. Instead of plastic becoming waste, the goal is to bring it back into the production cycle. For you as a technician, this means working in a real industrial environment with machinery, production lines, pumps, motors and technical installations that need to keep running every day. Relocation to the Netherlands The position is based in the eastern part of the Netherlands. Moving to another country is a big step, so we help you with the practical side of your relocation. We can support you with: Relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands Finding accommodation Registration and administration Practical arrangements before your move Support after you arrive
